title: Who Owns the Archive?
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: A fashion archive is not one asset. It is a governed constellation of physical objects, copyrights, marks, contracts, files, testimony, privacy interests, access permissions, and institutional obligations.
The record separates the material dress, House of Worth attribution, Charles Frederick Worth design credit, accession, and the museum’s present custody.

01 · INVENTORY — What is actually here?. Assign a persistent identifier to each object, file, recording, agreement, credential, and related record. Preserve original order and provenance before reorganizing for convenience.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · SEPARATE — Which interest attaches to which item?. Record physical title, copyright authorship and transfers, trademark or design records, contract limits, privacy, access, and conservation separately. One accession row may need several rights rows.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · GOVERN — Who may possess, use, reproduce, lend, digitize, describe, and dispose?. Turn vague control into verbs, responsible parties, territory, term, approval, exceptions, recovery, and a source document. Unknown is a valid status; guessed ownership is not.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · STEWARD — What must remain usable after a transfer?. Require identifiers, checksums, condition notes, formats, contextual narration, rights evidence, audit history, and a correction route to travel with the archive.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
